title: Delhi High Court sentences Rajpal Yadav to 3 months' imprisonment in cheque bounce case
description: The Delhi High Court on Friday sentenced Bollywood actor Rajpal Yadav to three months in jail in a cheque bounce case. Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma pronounced the verdict in a batch of seven cases filed against Yadav by M/s Murli Projects Private Limited.The Court sentenced him to three months' simple imprisonment in each of the seven cases but added that the sentences would run concurrently.
